name: banh-mi-cho-pos
description: Banh Mi Cho operational POS monorepo

scripts.build: npm run build -w @bmc/contracts && npm run build -w @bmc/cloud-api && npm run build -w @bmc/store-hub && npm run build -w @bmc/web-pos && npm run build -w @bmc/web-owner
scripts.check: npm run build -w @bmc/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @bmc/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @bmc/cloud-api && npm run typecheck -w @bmc/store-hub && npm run typecheck -w @bmc/web-pos && npm run typecheck -w @bmc/web-owner
